O’Hara played Kate McCallister in the Home Alone films and won an Emmy for her performance as Moira Rose in Schitt’s Creek.

Her death certificate later showed that she died from a pulmonary embolism, with rectal cancer listed as the underlying cause. She had been receiving cancer treatment before her death.

O’Hara’s career stretched for roughly five decades, beginning with the Canadian sketch-comedy institution SCTV and continuing through film, television and voice acting.
